subject: math
cluster: Draw and identify lines and angles, and classify shapes by properties of their lines and angles

items.prompt: A line of symmetry splits a shape into two parts that are what?

steps: A line of symmetry makes two matching halves.
The halves are mirror images of each other.

items.prompt: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?

steps: A square can fold to match along $4$ lines.
So it has $4$ lines of symmetry.

items.prompt: How many lines of symmetry does a rectangle (not a square) have?

steps: A non-square rectangle folds to match along $2$ lines.
So it has $2$ lines of symmetry.

items.prompt: Does a circle have many lines of symmetry?

steps: A circle can be folded to match along any line through its center.
So it has infinitely many lines of symmetry.

items.prompt: How many lines of symmetry does an equilateral triangle have?

steps: It folds to match along $3$ lines.

items.prompt: If a shape has no line that splits it into matching halves, how many lines of symmetry does it have?

steps: No matching fold means no line of symmetry.
